items.title: NiSource Generation Company: A new name that reflects a proven customer-first strategy
items.summary:
As northern Indiana continues to attract significant economic investment and energy demand growth, one thing remains unchanged: our commitment to protecting customers while supporting the region's future.  

That's why NIPSCO Generation LLC is now NiSource Generation Company LLC (GenCo).  

The new name better reflects the company's role within the broader NiSource enterprise while clearly distinguishing it from NIPSCO's traditional utility operations. Importantly, this is a name change only, not a change in strategy.

items.title: Inspiring Curiosity, Energizing the Future: NiSource Charitable Foundation Hosts Annual ‘Introduce a Girl to STEAM’ Event Across Five States

items.title: Federal Order Delays NIPSCO’s R.M. Schahfer Generating Station’s Retirement
items.summary: Northern Indiana Public Service Company LLC (NIPSCO) has received a federal order requiring the continued operation of R.M. Schahfer Generating Station beyond its previously scheduled retirement date of Dec. 31, 2025. The order is in effect for 90 days. We are reviewing the overall impact to our customers and company and will comply with this order, and any subsequent orders, if received, said Vince Parisi, NIPSCO President and Chief Operating Officer. We recognize the importance of both reliability and cost management for our customers, and we will continue to engage with federal, state and local stakeholders as we adapt to evolving regulatory requirements. NIPSCO and NiSource remain committed to delivering safe and reliable energy now and in the future. About NiSource NiSource Inc. (NYSE: NI) is one of the largest fully-regulated utility companies in the United States, serving approximately 3.3 million natural gas customers and 500,000 electric customers across six states
